opportunity.title: VA Enterprise Portal Section 508 Compliance Audit and Remediation
opportunity.placeOfPerformance: Remote, occasional travel to Washington DC
opportunity.description: The Department of Veterans Affairs requires a qualified contractor to perform a comprehensive Section 508 / WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit of the VA Enterprise Portal (approximately 200 web pages and 15 PDF documents) and remediate identified deficiencies. Scope includes: automated scanning using axe-core and Deque tools, manual keyboard-navigation and screen-reader testing (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver), detailed findings report with VPAT, and remediation of all critical and serious violations in HTML/CSS/JavaScript. The contractor must provide testing scripts and a re-audit at project close to confirm remediation. Period of performance: 90 days. This is an open competition with no set-aside restrictions; all responsible sources may submit offers.
